hints.title: Ordered Container for Lowest Available Seat
hints.text: Maintain the available seats in an ordered container to fetch the lowest numbered seat in logarithmic time.

hints.title: Heap Initialization
hints.text: initialize the min heap or track the next sequentially unreserved seat alongside a heap of recycled unreserved seats.

hints.title: Heap Push and Pop Operations
hints.text: when reserving, pop the top element from the min heap; when unreserving, push the seat number back onto the heap.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(log N) per reserve and unreserve
complexity.notes: Min-heap ensures lowest seat number is popped in O(log N) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning a boolean array to find the minimum available seat takes O(N) per reservation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Min heap supports O(log N) reserve and unreserve with O(N) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that a min priority queue directly solves the minimum-available requirement.
